Hero.title: Swiss cuisine, reimagined
Hero.lead: A tribute to the Alps — modern Swiss dishes, local ingredients and an experience you will never forget.

About.title: The mountains on your plate
About.heading: One family, one passion.
About.p1: For over 35 years, Alpine Kitchen has stood for authentic Swiss cuisine with a modern twist. What began in 1987 as a small family restaurant in Zurich is now a culinary institution.
About.p2: Our chef Stefan Brunner travels personally through the Swiss Alps to source the finest ingredients directly from farmers. Every dish tells a story of tradition, craftsmanship, and innovation.
About.p3: We are proud members of "Goût Mieux" and exclusively use seasonal, local products.
